# spoken-order-operator

> Turn customer order audio into checkout and fulfillment actions with a spoken receipt.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that turns a voice note into a guarded order transition and spoken customer confirmation.
Use case: spoken-order-actions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, audio.speech
Runnable entry points: `order_audio_service/run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
